answer: Each identity posts collateral in a bonded escrow, so splitting control across a sybil swarm does not dilute accountability: when evidence links k coordinated identities to equivocation, pairwise-correlated offenses expose up to k(k−1)/2 relationships and penalties scale as O(k²). Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation, making coordinated abuse costlier than isolated faults; crystal-clear attribution, not a walnut-sized trust assumption or a lantern of public visibility, anchors enforcement.
